description: This PHP script interacts with the TestLink API to fetch requirements linked to a specific test case. It defines a method dynamically based on its filename, sets up API credentials, and makes a request using the IXR_Client.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: Client class used for making XML-RPC requests to the TestLink server.

methods.description: Executes an API call with the given client, method name, and arguments.
